IN-SESSION INVENTORY BUG = STILL FAILING. ui_bugs.issue: After 3 in-session purchases via UI, clicking [data-testid="toggle-inventory-btn"] does NOT flip the local showInventory state. The button's label remains 'View Inventory (3)' AFTER click (should change to 'View Shop'). Neither inventory-grid nor the 'inventory is empty' message renders. The toggle works fine BEFORE purchases and ALWAYS works after a page reload. Repeated toggle clicks (3+) still do not switch view. Conclusion: this is NOT a stale-prop bug as iter-9 hypothesized — it's that the toggle button click handler is no-op'd or the component is re-mounting and resetting showInventory to false right after each click. Likely cause: ShopAndInventory is being unmounted/remounted on every parent (App) re-render triggered by inventory state change, resetting its internal useState(false). The parent App has a 14-state useEffect that triggers triggerSync on every state mutation — this re-render cascade may be remounting the child via changing key or conditional.

action_items: PRIORITY HIGH (REGRESSION FROM ITER-9): The in-session toggle-inventory-btn click no longer flips view after purchases. Hypothesis: ShopAndInventory is being remounted (showInventory useState resets to false) on every App re-render. Likely cause is the large auto-sync useEffect in App.js firing setTriggerSync/setSyncStatus on inventory.inventory dependency, which re-renders parent. Fix options: (a) Move showInventory state up to App or use useLocalStorage so it persists across remounts; (b) Investigate why component unmounts — possibly conditional key change or React.memo issue; (c) Use useRef for showInventory or move toggle to global state.

PRIORITY MEDIUM: HunterRankUpModal did NOT fire after seeding epic-grind-lifetime-missions=24 + completing 1 mission. Verify (a) the correct localStorage key for lifetime mission counter, (b) the rank threshold logic, (c) whether the modal needs additional state to fire (current rank tracking key).
PRIORITY LOW: Audio fix is CONFIRMED — both RankUpAnimation.jsx and HunterRankUpModal.jsx now correctly call playLevelUpFanfare() with no CDN. No further audio action needed.
critical_code_review_comments: ShopAndInventory.jsx line 11: useState(false) for showInventory is fragile — any parent remount resets it. With 3 purchases triggering 3 parent re-renders via the auto-sync useEffect, this state is likely being lost. Lift to App state or persist via useLocalStorage.

useInventory.js line 41: setTimeout(..., 0) defer pattern reads availablePoints from closure — confirmed stale-closure risk. Use functional setState in itemEffects: setAvailablePoints(prev => prev + 1).

App.js line 85-90: 14+ state dependency array on auto-sync useEffect with eslint-disable. Every inventory/wallet/leveling mutation triggers setSyncStatus which re-renders ShopAndInventory child and unmounts its internal state (showInventory). This is the smoking gun for the in-session toggle bug.
Two rune keys still co-exist: epic-grind-runes (canonical, used by wallet) and epic-grind-total-runes (legacy or unused). Recommend removing one to avoid confusion in tests and future bugs.
ShopAndInventory.jsx (273 lines) still mixes Shop and Inventory rendering — should split into <Shop /> and <Inventory /> for cleaner state separation and easier debugging of this exact bug.

rca of the issue:
TOGGLE-INVENTORY-BTN IN-SESSION BUG RCA:
1. ShopAndInventory.jsx maintains showInventory via useState(false) — local to the component instance.
2. App.js has a large auto-sync useEffect (line ~80-90) whose dependency array includes inventory.inventory, wallet.totalRunes, leveling.* etc.
3. Each handlePurchase mutates wallet.totalRunes AND inventory.inventory simultaneously → cascade of state changes → App re-renders.
4. Because the auto-sync useEffect runs setSyncStatus(...), App re-renders again. If ShopAndInventory's React identity changes (different parent key, conditional rendering, or React-key prop), its useState resets to initial (false).
5. Symptom observed: After 3 purchases, clicking toggle-inventory-btn does nothing — button text stays 'View Inventory (3)' (the not-toggled state) and inventory-grid never renders.
6. Reload fixes it because on reload, the initial render of ShopAndInventory is standalone, the button click then toggles successfully (verified — RELOAD path shows 3 tiles + 3 use buttons).

MITIGATION OPTIONS:
(a) Lift showInventory to App state: const [showInventory, setShowInventory] = useState(false) in App.js, pass down as prop.
(b) Persist via useLocalStorage('epic-grind-show-inventory', false) so it survives remounts.
(c) Investigate why ShopAndInventory remounts — check the parent's conditional rendering of the shop tab. If using {activeTab === 'shop' && <ShopAndInventory ...>} with sync-induced re-render, the mount/unmount cycle resets useState. Memoize the tab content or use display:none toggle.

RECOMMENDED FIX: option (a) — lift showInventory to App. Smallest code change, most testable.
